rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a newly forming plant leaf or flower.

example.english: A bud has just grown on the branch.
example.traditional: 條樹枝上面啱啱生咗一粒芽。
example.jyutping: tiu4 syu6 zi1 soeng6 min6 ngaam1 ngaam1 saang1 zo2 jat1 lap1 ngaa4

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a friend or buddy.

example.english: My bud helped me move house.
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 pang4 jau5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1

rows.note: Use this when addressing a man informally, as in “hey, buddy.”

example.english: Hey, bud, are you off work yet?
example.jyutping: lou5 jau5 fong3 gung1 mei6 aa3

rows.note: Use this for an idea, process, or feature that is just beginning to develop.

example.english: This idea has begun to bud.
example.traditional: 呢個構思已經開始萌芽。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kau3 si1 ji5 ging1 hoi1 ci2 mang4 ngaa4
